deployments_detail.use: Plans to invest 1.2 billion euros over five years in AI to reinvent its market-research business by 2030

Ipsos Facto, the company's proprietary generative AI platform / co-pilot for researchers, used to collect, manage, analyze and interpret research data. Built as a multi-model layer routing to third-party LLMs; by 2024 ~51% of the Ipsos workforce had used it and it was opened to clients. [Ipsos Facto (proprietary), routing to models from Google, OpenAI and Anthropic]
deployments_detail.value: 51% of the Ipsos workforce had already used Ipsos Facto

deployments_detail.use: Ipsos Synthesio Signals GenAI, a generative-AI application on the Synthesio social-listening platform that transforms millions of real-time consumer signals into actionable insights in about 60 seconds. [Ipsos Synthesio (generative AI)]
Ipsos PersonaBot, an AI-powered segmentation tool that turns research segments into conversational personas users can chat with, powered by Ipsos Facto. [Powered by Ipsos Facto (generative AI)]

InnoExplorer AI, an end-to-end innovation-exploration solution using generative and analytical AI plus consumer data to generate product/service ideas and concepts and predict their market potential. [Ipsos (generative + analytical AI)]

Product Studio, Ipsos' AI-native product-testing platform (launched across 11 markets) combining synthetic data, multi-modal AI, AI agents, smart labelling and generative-AI summaries to accelerate product testing. [Ipsos (multi-modal AI, AI agents)]

Synthetic respondents / AI digital-twin panels for market research — generating synthetic participants and 'digital twin' consumer panels for instant concept and product screening, developed via a research partnership with Stanford's PASCL. [Ipsos with Stanford PASCL]
Product View AI, an Ipsos HI+AI solution that reimagines product testing using AI to interpret consumer product feedback (part of the newer AI-native testing suite). [Ipsos (HI+AI)]

Creative|Spark AI, an AI-powered ad-testing / creative assessment solution that predicts human reactions to linear TV and social video (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube) and returns actionable insights within minutes. [Ipsos (HI+AI)]
deployments_detail.value: results in as little as 15 minutes

deployments_detail.use: Ipsos Synthesio AI Visibility / GEO — a generative-engine-optimization solution that monitors and reports how brands appear in AI search / LLM answers (ChatGPT, etc.), built in collaboration with MentionLab. [Ipsos Synthesio with MentionLab]
